feature: Generic extension Blob download, cache capture, online merge and Telegram feedback page
changes: Native WKDownload handles Blob/data URLs without transferring whole media payloads as Base64 messages. Accepted downloads outlive their source extension document.
Use the normal download queue, owned IDs, progress, completion and native callback lastError semantics. Temporary merge inputs do not create user download history.

Read extension-origin Blobs and Blobs owned by already granted public browser tabs through a native disk-backed stream with 192 KiB chunks. Reject foreign extension origins, inaccessible/private tabs and arbitrary network/file URLs; clean staging files on stream close, permission loss, unload or expiry.
Preserve real Blob message arguments across the JSON runtime/tabs message boundary using owned Blob references and receive-side restoration; keep publisher JavaScript unchanged.

Scope the real ManagedMediaSource equivalent to synchronous MAIN-world file-injection setup on iPhone, restore website feature detection afterwards, including when an injected file throws. Preserve native callback errors and publisher result counts.
Expose declared extension commands by long pressing the extension action icon, using WKWebExtensionContext.performCommand. No website user-agent spoofing.
Settings bottom Telegram entry now opens a dedicated themed page with the exact selectable URL, Copy Link and Open. Open tries tg://resolve?domain=soulobrowser, then the HTTPS link.

cat_catch_package.media: Locally generated 8-second color pattern and silent AAC; no third-party video

validation.byte_verification: Every binary download and the 32 MiB+17 cross-world stream matched the expected SHA-256

scope: Native third-party extension engine requires iOS/iPadOS 18.4+. Tests ran on iPhone/iPad simulators; no physical-device execution.
These results cover the requested workflows and regression packages, not certification of every store extension or Chrome API.
